C08-M09-L06-F1.title: Containment from request to verification
C08-M09-L06-F1.caption: A scoped, approved action is complete when its outcome is evidenced and remaining risk has an owner.
C08-M09-L06-F1.alt: Five connected boxes show evidence and risk, a scoped and approved action, preservation and execution, outcome verification and recording residual risk. A feedback arrow returns remaining exposures to scoping.

steps.label: Record risk and evidence
steps.sub: Artifact, identity, device or business process

steps.label: Scope and approve
steps.sub: Name the owner, target and expected effect

steps.label: Preserve and execute
steps.sub: Capture evidence and log the request

steps.label: Verify the outcome
steps.sub: Check the effect through a relevant source

C08-M09-L06-F1.note: A completed request and a verified outcome answer separate questions.
